root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash()` may execute the protected second tuple read `cbor_array_get(item, 1)`, it must establish that the incoming hash tuple has exactly two elements. The vulnerable original reaches the protected read with `cbor_array_size(item) == 1`; the fixed original is guarded on the stock PoC and the nearest direct-hash perturbation executes the same protected read with `cbor_array_size(item) == 2`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The missing source obligation is the exact tuple-arity check added ahead of tuple-style indexing in `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash()`.

nodes.description: At the second tuple read, the vulnerable original requests index 1 from the one-element hash array, so the sink-side tuple index is out of range before libcbor performs the crashing read.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `requested_index=1` and `item_array_size=1` at `hash_value_read`.

nodes.description: The file parser takes the direct-hash branch, so the `HASH` field value itself is passed into `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash()` rather than being iterated as an array of hash tuples.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `direct_hash_selected=1`, matching the source predicate `!cbor_isa_array(value)`.

edges.relation: The same `item` array whose arity is missing at the root site is the `item` later indexed at slot 1 by the sink read.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `hash_tuple_guard.item_ptr == hash_value_read.item_ptr`.

edges.relation: The direct-hash dispatch passes the same `pairs[i].value` array pointer unchanged into `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash()` as its `item` argument.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `hash_direct_dispatch.hash_array_ptr == hash_tuple_guard.item_ptr`.
